body:
Seems to be something with the quarkus cli?

If I run `./mvnw clean package -DskipTests -Dquarkus.container-image.build=true` I see

```
[INFO] [io.quarkus.container.image.docker.common.deployment.CommonProcessor] Starting (local) container image build for jar using podman
[INFO] [io.quarkus.container.image.docker.common.deployment.CommonProcessor] Executing the following command to build image: 'podman build -f /Users/edeandre/workspaces/IntelliJ/quarkus-kubernetes-kafka-db/src/main/docker/Dockerfile.jvm -t quay.io/kevindubois/demo:1.0.0 --platform linux/amd64 /Users/edeandre/workspaces/IntelliJ/quarkus-kubernetes-kafka-db'
```

But if I do `quarkus image build` I see what you see. It seems that the default image builder in the cli is docker.

If I run `quarkus image build podman` then it works as expected. I see

```
[INFO] [io.quarkus.container.image.docker.common.deployment.CommonProcessor] Starting (local) container image build for jar using podman
[INFO] [io.quarkus.container.image.docker.common.deployment.CommonProcessor] Executing the following command to build image: 'podman build -f /Users/edeandre/workspaces/IntelliJ/quarkus-kubernetes-kafka-db/src/main/docker/Dockerfile.jvm -t quay.io/kevindubois/demo:1.0.0 --platform linux/amd64 /Users/edeandre/workspaces/IntelliJ/quarkus-kubernetes-kafka-db'
```

(I did open #50855 because I saw the `podman` option was missing in the cli docs.

The "fix" here would be to enhance the quarkus cli to be able to determine the local container runtime environment. Thats outside the scope of the quarkus extensions.

Actually I looked into the cli code. All the cli does is call the `quarkus:image-build` maven goal. When I run that goal it behaves like @kdubois mentions.

Seems the `quarkus:image-build` maven goal should be aware of the container environment.

issue.title: Use podman when building container image from the CLI
